top_choice_rationale: Reversible-terminator sequencing-by-synthesis chemistry is a molecular design achievement that was completely new, is two decades mature and universally used, and a two-name citation restricted to that chemical lineage keeps attribution precise. P001 is a close second: the science is sound and broadly supported, but the citation joins two separately developed strands, leaves the heterobifunctional clinical record unproven, and excludes several credible contributors. P002 is mature and cleanly attributed but conceptually less novel and follows the 2010 palladium prize; P004 has unsettled in-cell evidence; a prize is still preferable to no award.
